name: Player monster
notes: The monster the human picked on the menu (its species comes from 'chosen'). The D-pad walks in 8 directions (diagonals as fast as straight). A = move 1, B = move 2, hold R with the D-pad untouched for 2 s = move 3: a ring of dots appears around the monster the moment R goes down and fills over those 2 s (grey = not ready, nothing fires); after move 3 fires, let go of R to charge it again. A charged move always goes off and uses its charge, even with no monster in reach (aiming is the player's job): its effect plays straight ahead. Moves recharge on their own timers; move 2 unlocks at level 4 and move 3 at level 7. HP starts at 60; each level adds 8 to the max and to the current HP. Sounds: B before move 2 unlocks, or R before move 3 unlocks, buzzes (sfx_error); a move that reaches no monster, or one that misses, whiffs (sfx_miss); a hit plays its type's hit sound (game.battle.player_hit_sounds), plus a ping when it is super effective. START pauses. When its HP runs out it blinks away and the run ends.
